userPrompt: When a drafted proposal for a new story is accepted, the new story goes into the Backlog, at its end, instead of into Next sprint. This covers Accept on a card and "Accept all" in the [Drafting](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#drafting) panel, and proposals from Ask answers too, since they are accepted the same way. Update [Creating](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#creating) so accepted proposals are named as the exception to "however a story is added, it goes into Next sprint". Update the Accept paragraph of [Proposals](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#proposals) so a new story goes into the Backlog. The story is still in its mode, still marked "From agent" with its sparkle, and keeps its spec citations. The card's note now reads "Added to Backlog", and its link opens the story there. Accepting a proposal never adds anything to Next sprint, so it never starts a sprint under [Auto Start](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#auto-start). An accepted story reaches a sprint only when it is moved to Next sprint, as the [Sprint](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#sprint) section says. Leave these alone: "Add to" proposals, which still add a step to the named story; the ribbon's and Planning's "New story", which still add to Next sprint; Duplicate; and the Ask card's "Add to sprint" in [Narrow](.claude/reference/scope/prompt-mode/ask-conversation/index.md#narrow), which still adds to Next sprint.
